_note: notifications-route-by-role-and-domain. Consumes openregister#3757 (notification-routing-per-group-and-scope). THREE declarations, none of which resolves a recipient in PHP. ONE, `case.authorization.roles` says which Nextcloud groups hold each role a notification rule may address. The dispatcher reads this map to turn `{kind: role, role: behandelaar}` into the people to tell, and it reads it at dispatch, so a colleague who joins the team tomorrow is reached by a rule written today. The same map is what a lifecycle transition reads, so the assignment changes in one place instead of in every rule that names the role. Every group named here is provisioned by \OCA\Dossiq\Repair\ProvisionAssignedGroups; a role assigned a group the server does not have records `recipient-unresolved` rather than delivering to nobody in silence, which is why the two lists are swept against each other by AuthorizationRolesAreProvisionedTest. TWO, each rule declares the `domain` it belongs to, which becomes the scope `domain:<name>`. A person may then pin one preference to `domain:zaken` and another to `domain:werkvoorraad`, and the dispatcher matches the rule's own domain. The domain is a literal on the rule, not a field read off the object: OpenRegister resolves no per-object domain, so dossiq declares one domain per rule and `caseType.notificationDomain` offers exactly those, never a free word that would pin a preference nothing ever matches. THREE, `caseType.notificationDomain` is the authoring surface for which domain a case type's notices fall under. A fragment rather than an edit to dossiq_register.json, per ADR-037, because several dossiq lanes build against that file at once.

notificationDomain.title: Notification domain
notificationDomain.description: Which notification domain this case type's notices fall under. A person pins a notification preference to a domain, so the value offered here is exactly the set the shipped rules declare: a free word would store a preference the dispatcher never matches, which reads as a switch that does nothing. Leave it on Zaken unless this type's work is genuinely a different slice.
